h1: TJ Boutique Hotel Uthai Thani — a small owner-run boutique in town that's spotless, quiet and detail-driven
intro: If you want a place in Uthai Thani town that isn't a big hotel but a small owner-run boutique — spotless, with little touches that make you feel more like a houseguest than a customer — TJ Boutique Hotel & Residence is the name guests in this neighbourhood keep praising. It's a 3-star boutique on Wong Sarot Road in Uthai Mai sub-district, near the town market. Air-con rooms come with a private balcony, a fridge (often with fruit waiting inside), free parking, and free bicycles to explore town. Rooms start from around ฿1,000/night.

body.html: What sets TJ Boutique Hotel apart from the usual places in Uthai Thani town is the hands-on, owner-led care. This is a small boutique, not a hundred-room hotel, and nearly every real guest review mentions an owner and staff who go beyond the price point — from the welcome and local tips on where to eat and what to see, to small details like fruit left in the in-room fridge. It suits travellers who value cleanliness and genuine service over flashy facilities.

It sits on Wong Sarot Road in Uthai Mai, in central Uthai Thani — within walking distance of the town market and the local history museum. Wat Uposatharam is about 1.2 km away, and the Sakae Krang River and Khao Sakae Krang hill are around 2.3 km, a few minutes by car. Wat Chantharam (Tha Sung), famous for its glass temple hall, is roughly 8 minutes' drive. The main commercial heart of town is a little way off at about 1.3 km — an easy walk, or a quick ride on one of the hotel's free bicycles.

Rooms are air-conditioned and each has a private balcony, a sitting area, a fridge, mini-bar, flat-screen TV, tea/coffee maker and hot water. They run about 22 sq.m., simply and cleanly styled. Guests are especially complimentary about the cleanliness — many say the rooms feel a notch above the price. Wi-Fi is free throughout, and there's a 24-hour front desk for late arrivals.
"A great place to stay when visiting Uthai Thani — spotlessly clean, complete amenities, fruit left in the room, and the kindest owner. Excellent value."

Breakfast here is served to your room rather than at a big buffet — reviews call it tasty and neatly presented, and the hotel can accommodate dietary needs if you let them know in advance. Another draw for those driving is the free private parking, plus bicycles to borrow for exploring. Uthai Thani is a small, flat town, so cycling to the morning market or along the Sakae Krang River is easy and pleasant.

To be straight with you, the main limitation comes from it being a small boutique with only a handful of rooms. On long weekends and holidays it books out fast, so reserve ahead. And because there's no in-house restaurant, meals other than breakfast mean heading out — which is no hardship, as the market and town eateries are close. The location also isn't right on the busiest commercial strip, so if you want shops the moment you step out the door, expect a short walk or ride first.

Overall, TJ Boutique Hotel scores around 8-plus out of 10 on booking platforms, 4.4 of 5 on Google from a solid number of guests, and 5 of 5 on TripAdvisor among small in-town stays in Uthai Thani. It isn't a luxury hotel, but measured on cleanliness, the owner's attentive service, balconied rooms, free parking and bikes, and rates starting around ฿1,000 (rising with season) — it's a well-judged choice for a quiet, warm stay in town.

A tip drawn from the reviews: book ahead, especially over long weekends, since rooms are limited. Flag a late arrival time in advance, and note any breakfast dietary needs beforehand. Borrowing the hotel's bikes for a ride along the Sakae Krang River at dawn or dusk is when Uthai Thani town looks its best.

faqTitle: FAQ — TJ Boutique Hotel Uthai Thani

faq.q: Where is TJ Boutique Hotel in Uthai Thani, and what's nearby?
faq.a: TJ Boutique Hotel is at 96/7 Wong Sarot Road, Uthai Mai, in central Uthai Thani town. It's within walking distance of the town market and the local history museum. Wat Uposatharam is about 1.2 km away, the Sakae Krang River about 2.3 km, and Wat Chantharam (Tha Sung) roughly 8 minutes by car.

faq.q: How much does TJ Boutique Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿1,000/night for a Standard room of about 22 sq.m. There are Standard, Deluxe and Superior rooms; all are air-conditioned with a private balcony, fridge and hot water. Prices rise with the season and room type, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does TJ Boutique Hotel have parking?
faq.a: Yes — free private parking, ideal if you're driving. There are also free bicycles to borrow for getting around town and riding along the Sakae Krang River.

faq.q: What are the rooms like — are they clean?
faq.a: Air-con rooms of about 22 sq.m., each with a private balcony, sitting area, fridge, mini-bar, flat-screen TV, tea/coffee maker and hot water. Real reviews especially praise the cleanliness, with many saying the rooms feel better kept than the price suggests, and fruit is often left in the in-room fridge.

faq.q: Does TJ Boutique Hotel serve breakfast or have a restaurant?
faq.a: The hotel serves breakfast to your room and can cater to dietary needs if you ask ahead. However, there's no on-site restaurant for other meals, so lunch and dinner mean heading out — which is easy, as the market and town eateries are close by.

faq.q: Who is TJ Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a strong fit for travellers who want a quiet, spotless in-town Uthai Thani stay with owner-led service — couples, small families, or drivers who value cleanliness and care. It isn't about luxury or resort-style facilities, but it's well-judged for a night or two on a comfortable budget.
